package main

import "runtime"

type Obj struct{ data [512]byte }
type Holder struct{ Ref *Obj }

var keep *Obj

func main() {
	// A package-level variable holds the object for the life of the process,
	// so the finalizer can never run.
	keep = &Obj{}
	runtime.SetFinalizer(keep, func(*Obj) {})
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
}
